meta.frame: All positions are centimetres in the VR weapon controller frame, F forward along the controller, L to the player's left, U up (QZD 17.3 HUD-model chain: models.cpp RenderHUDModel + hw_vrmodes GetWeaponTransform; tool/hands/gunview.py to_fl(hudrender.to_local)). Origin = the controller. vr_weaponScale assumed 1.02 as in hudrender.
meta.body_frame: Every reload frame is re-expressed in the gun body's READY pose: the body surface of that frame is rigidly fitted onto the body at the ready frame (residual < 0.05 cm on all guns surveyed), so part offsets are relative to the gun as the hand holds it. body_pose lists how much the HUD animation itself tilts/shifts the whole gun per frame.
meta.parts: separate_surface = the part is one or more whole md3 surfaces. Otherwise source[].vertex_ranges are inclusive vertex-index ranges (per surface) of the welded connected components that move together; a reload rebuild can split them into their own surface or move them per frame.
meta.magazine: well_point = centre of the magazine top when seated; well_mouth = where the magazine top crosses the lowest body geometry around the insert axis (the opening); insert_dir = unit direction the magazine travels going IN, from the authored animation (frame insert_dir_from_frame); insert_depth_cm = mouth->seated travel; base_point = centre of the magazine floor plate (where a hand holds it); farthest = authored farthest-out position (offset from seated).
meta.handle: grab_point = centre of the part's end that leads in the pull direction; pull_dir unit; travel_cm = authored maximum travel (centroid), at max_frame.
meta.swing: hinge_axis/hinge_point = rotation axis of the authored open frame relative to closed; swing_angle_deg; open_centroid = part centre when open.
meta.mag_out_frames: mesh frames whose magazine is out of the well (or hidden), with the body tilt of that frame; usable as the gun's mag-out pose if the magazine surface/vertices are hidden or moved.
meta.mesh_frame: BD22: indices into the STRIPPED meshes of RS_BD22_Models_v8.pk3 (FrameIndex numbers of its MODELDEF.bd.txt), not the full meshes. V+: indices into the set's own md3.
meta.reload_flow: Emulated from the DECORATE as authored (BD22 originals from brutal22test6.pk3, V+ originals), with the inventory given. Rows are displayed states (tics > 0); sounds/ammo/spawns are those of the 0-tic states just before plus the row's own state. A_JumpIf(expr) and random A_Jump are not taken (listed as unmodelled). ammo = net change of ammo-like items.
